lessons.title: Lesson 1: Modern technological devices and AI applications
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Modern technological devices and AI applications.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Used to communicate what someone else said without quoting their exact words. Typically requires shifting tenses back (backshift), changing pronouns, and updating time/place markers.
concepts.example: Direct: 'I am reading a tech blog,' Minh said. -> Reported: Minh said that he was reading a tech blog.
concepts.essence: Allows the reporting speaker to integrate another person's statement smoothly into the current narrative context.

rules.statement: Tense shift rule in Reported Speech
rules.meaning: When the reporting verb is in the past (said, told), shift the verb in the quote one tense back: Present Simple -> Past Simple; Present Continuous -> Past Continuous; Will -> Would; Can -> Could.
rules.example: 'We will test the robot tomorrow' -> They said that they would test the robot the following day.
rules.essence: Reflects the temporal distance between the moment of original utterance and the moment of reporting.

workedExamples.prompt: Change into reported speech: 'Lan said: "My father works as a software engineer at a tech company."'
steps: Step 1: Change pronoun: 'My father' becomes 'Her father'.
Step 2: Shift tense: Present Simple 'works' becomes Past Simple 'worked'.
Step 3: Combine with reporting clause: 'Lan said that her father worked as a software engineer at a tech company.'
workedExamples.answer: Lan said that her father worked as a software engineer at a tech company.

commonMistakes.mistake: Forgetting to change time words: keeping 'tomorrow' instead of 'the next day / the following day'.
commonMistakes.why: Time markers are anchored to the original moment of speaking; when reported later, they must be adjusted relative to the present.
